description:
Role: AEM Template developer
 Location: Remote
 Number of positions 3 
 Duration: 12+ Months
 Experience Needed: 5+ Years
  
 Note: Looking for someone who can handle template development and also has strong Java Full Stack experience, including hands-on Java coding.
   
 Position details 
 Required Skills: Primary Platform: AEM Forms 6.5 LTS Form Design Tools: AEM Forms Designer / Adobe LiveCycle Designer.
 AEM Template developer Requirement: Create and maintain complex XDP form templates using AEM Forms Designer (Former LiveCycle Designer) for print, web, and correspondence channels.
 Structure XDP layouts with subforms, target areas, tables, layout fragments, and dynamic images.
 Map XDP templates with XML Schema (XSD), Form Data Models (FDM), and JSON datasets to enable dynamic data prefill and secure submission.
 - Strong Experience Languages: Java, JavaScript, HTML5 - Strong Experienced Core Frameworks: OSGi, Apache Sling, JCR, Form Data Model (FDM)
 - Experienced Data Formats: XML, XSD, XFA, JSON, Document Fragments
 - Experienced Tools & Build: Maven, Git, Eclipse
 - Experienced Preferred Skills: Jira, Shell Scripting, Batch scheduling activities
 Responsibilities: AEM template development at a fast pace to accomplish a large migration effort.
 Batch monitoring and pager support.
 Coach team members as needed in AEM template development activities.
 Expected Deliverable(s): Successful deliver of the multi phased migration effort.
 Development documentation, revision of standards and guidelines.
